# Fixture data

`tiny.osm.pbf` is a small regional OpenStreetMap extract used by integration
tests. It is © OpenStreetMap contributors and licensed under the Open Database
License (ODbL): https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/

To refresh from Geofabrik:

```bash
curl -L -o testdata/tiny.osm.pbf \
  https://download.geofabrik.de/europe/monaco-latest.osm.pbf
```
